ratings.why: Locals' favorite goat stew; very limited hours
ratings.summary: Reviewers love the authentic goat stew and local vibe at fair prices; the main gripes are the short weekend-only hours and that dishes sell out. A few older TripAdvisor reviews found the stew gristly.

name: Cactus Blue food truck
note: Burgers, wraps, lionfish burgers (they sell out). Mon–Fri 11:00–15:00. At Donkey Beach / dive site #37 Corporal Meiss, start of the runway.

ratings.summary: Repeatedly called the best burgers on the island, especially the lionfish burger, with very friendly owners and fresh juices; the only common complaint is price (~$26 for a lionfish burger).
ratings.flag: Hours differ by source: bonaire.com shows Tue–Thu 11–15 only, vs Mon–Fri elsewhere. Check before driving.

name: Posada Para Mira
note: Rincon local stews $18–21, veggie plate $20. Hours conflict between sources, call ahead.

ratings.summary: Praised for goat and beef stew, iguana soup, conch and fresh fish in a garden setting with hill views and friendly service; the main knock is that it isn't cheap.

name: Rose Inn / Kos Bon So

ratings.why: Cheap, generous local plates in Rincon
ratings.summary: Two neighbouring local spots: Kos Bon So is liked for ribs, grilled chicken, conch and cold cheap beer with big portions; Rose Inn for goat/beef stew and personal service. Downsides: disposable plates and some waits.
ratings.flag: This pin combines two separate places; ratings are listed per place.

ratings.summary: Fans like the fresh bread, pastechi and coconut treats and the caring service; the main warning is that items sell out early.

name: Alma Lusa Bakery

ratings.summary: Some find everything tasty and high quality; others report little stock, small, pricey portions and closing earlier than posted.

note: Breakfast from 7:00 next to the dive boats (hours unverified).

ratings.summary: Recent diners praise the tuna steak, ribs, fresh fish, cocktails and the Thursday BBQ in a small-harbour setting; few complaints in recent reviews.

name: Blennies (Buddy Dive)
note: Over the dive dock. Breakfast buffet 7–10 $27, plus lunch and dinner.

ratings.summary: The sunset view and breakfast spot get compliments, but 2026 reviews complain about greasy or lukewarm food, long waits and wrong orders.

name: Rum Runners (Captain Don's Habitat)
note: Daily 7–22, Monday BBQ night. Kaya Gob. N. Debrot 103.

ratings.summary: People like the waterfront view and some pizzas; recent reviews are split, with cold or flavorless ribs and unfriendly staff on some nights.

name: Cuba Compagnie
note: Cuban/local, Kaya Grandi 1. Kitchen from 17:00, Thursday salsa night; reserve.

ratings.why: Fun Thursday salsa night, good value
ratings.summary: Loved for the lively atmosphere, mojitos, tuna and snapper and the Thursday salsa night; complaints include slow or inattentive service and some salty or bland dishes.

name: Bon Tapa

ratings.why: Tasty tapas, a few recent misses
ratings.summary: Most reviewers enjoy the varied tapas (honey chicken, garlic shrimp, short rib) and friendly staff; a few 2026 reviews mention stale bread, flies and weaker value than before.

name: Sebastian's
note: Waterfront, mains ~$28–40. Sunday Italian night, Wednesday 4-course $39. Reserve a pier table for sunset.

ratings.why: Go for the sunset pier, not the food
ratings.summary: The pier sunset setting is the star; food reviews are average and service is often called slow, with high prices.

name: Mezze
note: Mediterranean, vegetarian/vegan friendly. Tue–Sat 18:00–22:30, closed Sun–Mon.

ratings.summary: Recent Google reviews praise the hummus, octopus, ribeye, halal and vegan options and a welcoming owner; several TripAdvisor regulars say quality dropped after the restaurant was sold (slower service, smaller menu, higher prices).
ratings.flag: Reported sale/ownership change; older ratings may not reflect the current kitchen.

name: Brass Boer (Delfins)

ratings.summary: October 2026 reviews (after the Aug 2026 reopening) are glowing about the tasting menu, sunset setting and service; the main caveat is price. TripAdvisor's rating includes many pre-reopening reviews.
ratings.flag: Reopened Aug 2026 with a new menu, so older reviews may not apply.

note: Julio A. Abraham Blvd 87. Closed Wed/Thu. Christmas dinner Dec 25–26, $120.

ratings.why: Consistently excellent, a top-10 on TripAdvisor
ratings.summary: Recent reviews consistently praise the fresh fish (red snapper), shrimp, drinks and warm, welcoming service, a good post-dive dinner. No recurring complaints in the 2026 reviews sampled.

name: Capriccio
note: Italian. Closed Mon–Tue.

ratings.summary: Loved for real Italian cooking (vitello tonnato, pasta), an extensive wine list and first-class service; reserve, it books up. Few complaints in 2026.
